comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked against a measured twelve-cell table: the split-parents household with the filer having signed the declaration away and more nights with the child. The custodial parent keeps the EITC (line 33 unchanged at 6,345) and loses the CTC (line 24 1,465 -> 3,665; line 16 the same 3,665, so the 2,200 is provably the credit); line 34 follows (4,880 -> 2,680).
